rationale: The description covers conventional data joining, real-time analysis and visualization, and profile unification. Per-customer journey tailoring from past behavior is ambiguous, because rules versus predictive models is not established, so this is a forced weak non-AI judgment.
evidence_spans: that lets you join all of your data from every channel into a single interface for real-time, omnichannel analysis and visualization
Journey Orchestration is a service built on Adobe Experience Platform that allows you tailor individual journeys for every customer based on their previous behavior and preferences.
